0:
Change and set the wrestler's name,
height, weight, entrance music, etc.

@BProfile@D changes are possible even
for non-original wrestlers.
1:
Set the wrestler's face, body type,
costume, etc. in fine detail.

@BAppearance@D changes are possible
even for non-original wrestlers.
10:
Choose the name the ring announcer
calls when introducing the wrestler.

Press $8 to hear the ring call.

@B(Bonus)@D
　　You can also choose ring calls for
　　All Japan wrestlers who do not
　　appear in this game.
11:
Set the mic appeals the wrestler
can do before and after matches.

@B(How to use)@D
　　Hold $6$7$8$9 during the entrance
　　or after the match to show the mic
　　appeal for that button.

@Y(How to register)@D
　　Register the mic appeal text itself
　　in @GMic Appeal@D under @BOptions@D.
12:
Set the reversal style for grapples
that can be reversed. Choose from
6 options: Heavy, Heavy Special,
Jr. Heavy, Jr. Heavy Special,
Martial Arts, Heel.

@G[Example: reversing a powerbomb]@D
　　- Heavy / Martial Arts -> Reverse Suplex
　　- Heavy Special / Jr. Heavy Special
　　-> Huracan Whip
　　- Jr. Heavy -> Huracanrana (Hold)
　　- Heel -> Poison Mist
13:
Set attack power for each body part.
With these points, the same move
deals different damage depending
on the wrestler.

The parts are @BHead, Body, Arms,
Legs, Flying@D: 5 in all.

@G(How to)@D
　　Point at a part and press $d to
　　raise it, $c to lower it.
　　Freely assign the basic @B10 points@D.
14:
Set defense power for each body part.
With these points, the same move
deals different damage depending
on the wrestler.

The parts are @BHead, Body, Arms,
Legs, Anti-Flying@D: 5 in all.

@G(How to)@D
　　Point at a part and press $d to
　　raise it, $c to lower it.
　　Freely assign the basic @B10 points@D.
15:
Set the wrestlers who run in during
matches and accompany as seconds.
Run-in wrestlers are only used in
matches with @BInterference@D on.

Lower-numbered wrestlers are more
likely to run in. With no run-in
wrestler set, the computer picks
one at random from all wrestlers.

The second who appears is @RTYPE 4@D.
16:
The wrestler set here is very likely
to run into the match of the wrestler
you are editing.

To have a specific wrestler run in,
set him here.

Set to @BNone@D and the run-in
wrestler is chosen at random.
17:
The wrestler set here runs in a
little less often than @BRun-In
Wrestler 1@D.

Set this if there is another wrestler
you want to run in besides
@BRun-In Wrestler 1@D.

Set to @BNone@D and the run-in
wrestler is chosen at random.
18:
The wrestler set here runs in a
little less often than @BRun-In
Wrestler 2@D: only very rarely.

Set all 3 run-in wrestlers and the
run-in will always be one of the 3,
with no random element. Use this to
limit run-ins to 3 wrestlers.

Set to @BNone@D and the run-in
wrestler is chosen at random.
19:
The wrestler set here accompanies
the wrestler you are editing on his
entrance, and helps as a backup
when running in during a match.

There is no downside to setting one,
so choose whoever you like.

But please don't attack the
opponent's second.
2:
Freely change and set the wrestler's
moves.

Up to @G5 moves@D per wrestler can each
be given @YKO@D and @Rbleeding@D effects.
Point at a set move and press $2 for
@YKO@D or $3 for @Rbleeding@D. Doing this
on a move that already has one set
removes it instead.

@Y(Note)@D
　　Only original wrestlers can have
　　their moves changed. The moves of
　　built-in wrestlers cannot be changed.
20:
Set which move finishes the match.
Choose 1 from the wrestler's moves.
3:
Set the wrestler's style, stance,
attack, defense, and other settings.

@Y(Note)@D
　　Only original wrestlers can have
　　their parameters changed. The
　　parameters of built-in wrestlers
　　cannot be changed.

　　On the wrestler select screen, the
　　original wrestlers you can change
　　have @Bgray@D name plates. (Wrestlers
　　you cannot change have @Rdark red@D
　　name plates.)
4:
Set the basic behavior pattern used
when the computer controls the
wrestler.

@Y(Note)@D
　　Only original wrestlers can have
　　their logic changed. The parameters
　　of built-in wrestlers cannot be
　　changed.

　　On the wrestler select screen, the
　　original wrestlers you can change
　　have @Bgray@D name plates. (Wrestlers
　　you cannot change have @Rdark red@D
　　name plates.)
5:
Copy another wrestler's data onto
the wrestler you are viewing.

@G(How to)@D
　　Press @BCopy from Another Wrestler@D
　　and select the wrestler to copy from.
　　To skip an item, select it with $a$b
　　and press $0: it will be dimmed and
　　not copied.
6:
Restore the wrestler you are viewing
to his original default data.

@G(How to)@D
　　Select the item for a dedicated
　　screen. To keep an item from being
　　restored, select it with $a$b and
　　press $0: it will be dimmed and
　　not restored.
7:
Set the wrestler's voice during
matches.

The voice set here as @BVoice A@D is
used mainly for shouts when
attacking.

Press $8 to hear the voice.
8:
Set the wrestler's voice during
matches.

The voice set here as @GVoice B@D is
used mainly when taunting.

Press $8 to hear the voice.
9:
Choose the music played for the
wrestler's entrance.

Press $8 to hear the music.
